# Oracle

> Oracle provides enterprise cloud applications and software solutions for ERP, HCM, CRM, supply chain, healthcare, and data management with AI-powered automation capabilities.

Oracle's portfolio spans customer experience (CX), human capital management (HCM), enterprise resource planning (ERP), supply chain management (SCM), and healthcare solutions. The site emphasizes cloud migration, digital transformation, and AI-driven business intelligence across enterprise operations.

## Key Topics

- Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications
- Cloud ERP
- AI and Machine Learning
- Digital Transformation
- Customer Experience (CX)
- Human Capital Management (HCM)
- Supply Chain Management (SCM)
- Healthcare Solutions
- Data Governance
- Sales Performance Management
- Marketing Automation
- Transportation Management
- Employee Experience
- Cloud Migration
- Enterprise Automation

## Cloud Applications & AI Automation

- [Agents That Know Your Business: The Oracle Fusion Advantage](https://www.oracle.com/applications/agents-that-know-your-business): Oracle Fusion AI Agents for enterprise automation and business context
- [On-premise limitations, cloud possibilities: AI Strategies for Leaders](https://www.oracle.com/applications/effective-ai-strategies): AI strategies for cloud migration from legacy systems like JD Edwards
- [10 Differences between Oracle and SAP](https://www.oracle.com/erp/oracle-vs-sap/differentiators): Oracle Fusion vs SAP S/4HANA: ERP platform comparison and differences
- [15 Top Cloud ERP Benefits & Reasons to Move](https://www.oracle.com/erp/cloud-erp-benefits): Cloud ERP benefits guide for digital transformation and SaaS migration

## Customer Experience & Sales

- [Oracle is a Leader in CRM Customer Engagement Center (CEC)](https://www.oracle.com/applications/crm-customer-engagement-center-gartner-mq): Oracle CRM Customer Engagement Center recognized as Gartner leader
- [Sales Performance Management](https://www.oracle.com/cx/sales/sales-performance-management): Oracle Sales Performance Management and incentive compensation platform
- [Marketing automation scalability and reliability](https://www.oracle.com/cx/marketing/automation/eloqua-scalability-reliability): Oracle Eloqua marketing automation platform scalability and reliability

## Human Capital Management

- [Strategies for the CHRO](https://www.oracle.com/human-capital-management/best-hr): CHRO strategies for HR transformation using Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM
- [What Is the Employee Experience?](https://www.oracle.com/human-capital-management/employee-experience/what-is-employee-experience): Definition and guide to employee experience strategy and HR practices
- [What Is Recruiting Software?](https://www.oracle.com/human-capital-management/recruiting/what-is-recruiting-software): Recruiting software and ATS guide for hiring and candidate management
- [The Real Cost of Turnover in Healthcare](https://www.oracle.com/human-capital-management/cost-employee-turnover-healthcare): Healthcare employee turnover costs and workforce management insights

## Supply Chain & Logistics

- [Product Tour—Machine learning for transit time prediction](https://www.oracle.com/scm/logistics/transportation-management/transportation-management-tour): Oracle Transportation Management with machine learning ETA prediction
- [Oracle Transportation Management: Fleet Management Product Tour](https://www.oracle.com/scm/logistics/transportation-management/fleet-management-product-tour): Oracle Fleet Management product tour for route planning and tracking

## Healthcare Solutions

- [i.s.h.med](https://www.oracle.com/health/ishmed): i.s.h.med EHR and hospital management system with clinical workflows
- [Reporting and Analytics](https://www.oracle.com/health/reporting-analytics): Oracle Health reporting and analytics for EHR and population health

## Finance & Data Management

- [14 CFO Best Practices for 2024](https://www.oracle.com/erp/cfo/cfo-best-practices): CFO best practices for financial strategy and digital transformation
- [Test-drive Enterprise Data Management (EDM)](https://www.oracle.com/performance-management/enterprise-data-management/rapid-start): Oracle EDM Rapid Start free trial for data governance and master data

## Optional

- [What Is the Metaverse](https://www.oracle.com/erp/ai-financials/what-is-the-metaverse): Metaverse explained: extended reality, virtual worlds, and blockchain
- [AutoVue Enterprise Visualization Solutions](https://www.oracle.com/applications/autovue): AutoVue enterprise visualization for CAD and document collaboration
